text: Latency, throughput limits, and the absence of fully automated continuous training and validation together defeat the timeliness advantage that real-time data is supposed to deliver.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: Latency, data throughput constraints, and the absence of fully automated mechanisms for continuous training and validation can collectively undermine the timeliness of insights derived from AI models.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: AI pipelines ingesting live, high-velocity data streams
